purpose: KNOWLEDGE CONSTRUCTION ON EARNINGS-22 (owner ruling 2026-09-07, 'once E22 is aligned it can be knowledge-enhanced too'): does supplying the call's OWN pre-meeting brief -- the five facts the Earnings-22 corpus publishes about it -- change what the frozen core transcribes on the admitted tail-silence-2s serving surface? TWO cells, ONE factor each. KC-E2 supplies the call's own brief; KU-E2c supplies ANOTHER call's brief at the same shape, so the arm-versus-twin contrast isolates the brief's CONTENT. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-07-e22-kc-e2-pre-meeting-brief-v1-preregistration.md. NOT AUTHORIZED by this fragment: the cells need the owner's GO, their own exposure rows registered before the first contact, their own contracts.ExecutionPlan, and the two preconditions of the preregistration's section 8 -- the measured prompt fit and the token-matched twin.

read_the_audit_first.what_it_means: The brief's DIRECT channel is measured and it is 0.0229 corpus-WER points, an order of magnitude below this runtime's own same-request null of [-0.2356, +0.0692] on this roster. Every one of the 47 covered reference words belongs to a term that also occurs in calls the term does not describe. This fragment exists so the cell is expressible and reviewable; whether it is worth a GPU hour is the owner's call and the preregistration's section 9 states the case both ways.

basis.serving_surface: docs/readiness/2026-09-07-e22-dev-encoding-probes-v1-verdict.md -- tail-silence-2s is ADMITTED on all three clauses and is the recommended Earnings-22 short-form serving default: corpus WER 9.4054 on these 1,500 rows against arm A's 17.4012, boundary block 8.2778 -> 1.1085
basis.why_the_comparator_is_the_tail2s_arm_and: a knowledge cell must be measured on the serving surface the study actually recommends, or it measures the encoding defect instead of the knowledge
basis.brief_source: core.metadata_brief -- the corpus's own metadata.csv and nothing else; owner ruling 2026-09-07, Earnings-22 collects no external information
basis.metric: reproduction.brief_term_recall (brief-term-recall-v1), defined and measured on the comparator BEFORE this cell existed

comparator.restricted_to: the same 1,500 published segments, on the same tail-silence-2s media
comparator.join_rule: both arms fly the @ts2 ids; the published segment key is recovered by splitting on '@', which is what makes the paired join against the sealed rows exact
comparator.why_sealed_and_never_a_rerun: Greedy decoding is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions on this runtime, so the contrast is against sealed outputs. No new comparator is flown.

same_request_null.binding: an effect is claimed only if its CI90 excludes this interval; a preregistered effect smaller than about 0.25 points on 1,500 rows cannot be distinguished from this null by one flight

E22-ESB-DEV1500-TAIL2S-UTTERANCES.estimand: the paired within-segment effect of supplying the call's own metadata brief, on corpus WER and on brief-term recall, against sealed rows on a population this study is allowed to optimize on
E22-ESB-DEV1500-TAIL2S-UTTERANCES.dataset_fragment_unchanged: The dataset fragment is the comparator's own, byte for byte. This cell varies the REQUEST and nothing about the media, the roster, the reference layer or the split identity.

cells.serving_geometry: -c 40960 -np 8, 5120 tokens per slot -- the sealed comparator's, unchanged
cells.factor: the call's OWN pre-meeting brief at the head of the system message: ticker, country, UN region, dialect family, language family, each with its Whisper-normalized form where casing moves it
cells.what_it_separates: whether five published facts about a call change what the core transcribes of it, on the serving surface this study recommends

cells.serving_geometry: -c 40960 -np 8, 5120 tokens per slot -- identical to KC-E2's
cells.factor: the FORM twin: another call's brief, chosen by the pinned fixed-point-free call derangement, at the same shape and the same five labels
cells.what_it_separates: the brief's CONTENT from its FORM and its token volume. The arm-versus-twin contrast is the ONE-factor contrast; the arm-versus-comparator contrast moves the evidence AND the task instruction and is reported as such, never quoted as the content effect.

shared_protocol.audio_path: raw audio, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU, no feature cache directory
shared_protocol.obs: none -- an ESB utterance IS the request; there is no windowing here
shared_protocol.harness: core.flight.FlightRuntime with the shared rails zero-supply direct arm and the OpenJiuwen executor, entered through scripts/flights/run_e22_esb_cell.py -- the same harness and the same entry point the sealed comparator used
shared_protocol.prompt_shape: the base TaskAdapter.assemble_prompt default: one system message, one user message carrying the audio. The brief is the HEAD of the system message, in the '[evidence <id>] <content>' line format core.model.transport renders supplied_evidence in, so the payload's field set stays exactly ARM_VISIBLE_FIELDS['bare-core'] -- the comparator's own.
shared_protocol.evidence_rail: scripts/flights/run_e22_esb_cell.py resolves the fragment's evidence_source through core.base.EVIDENCE_SOURCES once, before the flight, and registers every item's DerivedEvidenceRecord with core.evidence_derivation.DerivedEvidenceRegistry against the params core.evidence.resolve_declared_transform_params reads from THIS composed config -- the same rail core.driver.run_experiment runs. A source that lied about its params, its transform or its content stops the flight before a server exists.
shared_protocol.the_only_difference: between the two cells, the CONTENT of the brief. Between either cell and the sealed comparator, the brief plus the instruction preamble that describes it.

deviations.deviation: the task instruction gains a preamble describing the brief, and the word 'listed' inside the anti-insertion sentence
deviations.why: an arm that supplies reference material must say what it is, and must warn against reading it aloud; the KC-E1 Earnings-21 brief instruction carries the identical change for the identical reason
deviations.expected_effect: the arm-versus-COMPARATOR contrast moves two things and is reported as such; the arm-versus-TWIN contrast moves one, because the twin's instruction is byte-identical to the arm's

deviations.deviation: the brief's evidence record carries carrier_bound=False, so the D1 evidence-identity rail does not run for it
deviations.why: D1 records the Earnings-22 metadata table's 125 ids through data.identity._csv_layer and no per-file manifest, so there is no per-sample evidence identity to check against. A saea-d1-evidence-supplement-v1 cannot be written either: contracts.gate.FrozenCoreGate allows at most ONE supplement per gate and this cell must carry the media supplement, and gate_evidence_identity requires an evidence supplement's ids_sha256 to equal the carrier's own evidence layer universe, which earnings22-original does not have.
deviations.expected_effect: identity rests on the derivation chain plus the composed config's byte pin on the table, which is re-hashed on every read; the honesty is stated in the fragment, in core.metadata_brief and in the audit note rather than papered over

evaluation.paper_facing_aggregation: corpus: total S+D+I over total reference words
evaluation.agentic_metric: analysis.e22_error_taxonomy at its committed version, recomputed on the new outputs, on the DEV10 inventory basis -- named in the flight receipt, per the 2026-09-07 verdict's standing reporting obligation
metrics: corpus WER under the Whisper EnglishTextNormalizer, pooled and per call (paper-facing anchor)
brief-term recall, pooled and per field and per call (the targeted metric)

numeric-value accuracy, computed post-seal from the sealed rows (there is no ESB-scoped numeric scorer registration; the carrier-layer numeric-value-accuracy-v1 resolves a CALL's .nlp reference and cannot key an utterance)
the semantic high-impact rate, from analysis.e22_error_taxonomy on the DEV10 basis
corpus and mean WER under the frozen saea-scoring-v1 normalizer
substitutions / deletions / insertions, reference words, and the hypothesis-to-reference length ratio -- a brief that gets read aloud shows up in the insertion share first
prompt_tokens against the prompt fit's own predicted per-row text envelope

paired_analysis.signed_as: cell minus comparator, and cell minus twin, on the same 1,500 published segments, paired per segment

mandatory_slices: the per-call table for all ten calls, corpus WER under both normalizers
natural-mixture and equal-call weightings side by side
the per-FIELD brief-term recall table with its reference-word counts
the call-specific versus shared-vocabulary split of the term mass
the insertion / deletion / substitution split and the hypothesis-to-reference length ratio
the brief's flight-tokenizer token distribution, and the twin's beside it

execution_plan_basis.per_cell: each of the two cells carries its own run id, its own exposure row and its own plan; the figures above are PER CELL
execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 1,500 rows x 1 contact + 8 canaries = 1,508; the registered exposure ceiling is 1,600 per cell.
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 12948.983 s for one pass, rounded up to 13000; the registered ceiling is 13500 per cell.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 0.30 planned, 0.50 registered per cell. Derived rather than guessed: the sealed tail-silence-2s comparator realized 0.1188 GPU-h for exactly this roster, this geometry and this audio path. The brief adds text tokens to a prompt whose cost is dominated by the live mmproj encode, so the realized figure should land near 0.15 h and the 0.50 ceiling carries better than a 3x margin.
execution_plan_basis.cumulative_metering: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are each exposure row's own calls / speech-audio-seconds / gpu-hours cells, and the plan budget is metered CUMULATIVELY across every attempt of a run id, so a recovery plan must cover prior durable spend as well as its own worst case.

decision.rule: ADMITTED iff BOTH hold on the reported roster: (1) corpus WER is NON-INFERIOR -- the call-clustered CI90 UPPER bound on the delta (cell minus comparator) is <= +0.10 absolute points; AND (2) brief-term recall IMPROVES -- the call-clustered CI90 LOWER bound on the delta is > 0 against BOTH the sealed comparator AND the KU-E2c twin.
decision.null: NULL if either brief-term-recall lower bound includes 0. A NULL with a positive point estimate against the twin and a negative one against the comparator is reported as 'the form carried it', and the next cell is a supply-form question, not a content one.
decision.harmful: HARMFUL if the corpus-WER non-inferiority bound fails, with the failing guard named and the per-call table published either way.
decision.non_inferiority_margin_provenance: +0.10 absolute corpus-WER points, fixed here before any number exists. It is deliberately TIGHTER than the 0.25-point resolution the same-request null implies, so the guard can only ever refuse a cell, never admit one on noise.
decision.power_disclosure: The audit measured the brief-term denominator at 47 reference words over 10 clusters with 6 errors on them. Clause 2 is therefore, on this roster, a gate on six words, and no bootstrap over 10 call clusters produces a usable interval on it. This is stated in the rule rather than discovered in the verdict: a NULL here is the expected outcome and is not evidence that knowledge does not help this carrier.
decision.claim_surface: A dev number on a 1,500-row subset of this study's own dev split. NOT an alignment verdict, never compared to the published 9.79 or 12.3 as a difference, and no generalization to Earnings-21, to other carriers or to richer knowledge sources.
decision.test_read: NONE. Not proposed and not authorized on this fragment's authority.
decision.not_authorized: No second mechanism. No knob tuned on the test split. No fourth prompt. No few-shot. No post-processing of any hypothesis. No re-scoring of any sealed arm. No external source of any kind. No paper-scale-confirmatory profile, no manuscript, no submission, no Stage-3 activity.

preconditions: PROMPT FIT, on the flight tokenizer: scripts/e22_kc_e2_prompt_fit.py must measure both cells' rendered requests at -c 40960 -np 8 and satisfy slot_tokens >= 2 x worst_required. Not run here; it touches the server and is the flight agent's step.

TOKEN-MATCHED TWIN: the same script writes configs/knowledge/e22-brief-v1/pad-plan-v1.json, and KU-E2c's fragment then moves to the e22-metadata-brief-deranged-token-matched source with its evidence_brief_pad_plan pin. Until that lands, the twin is whitespace-shaped and no verdict may be drawn from it.
OWNER GO and one exposure row per cell, registered and committed before the first contact.

companion_run.note: A 4-row smoke gets its own fragment and its own run id when the flight agent prepares takeoff, for the reason configs/experiment/e22-dev-encoding-tail2s-v1.json records: contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's, and a smoke's rows have a different split identity hash and a much smaller budget.
